integrity: Exact algebra verified with the included symbolic script; the global argument and center-stable tracking are analytical, not independently validated.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes b>0 and a<0; it does not classify interior non-equilibrium compact invariant sets or unbounded orbits. The critical asymptotic is for bounded forward trajectories outside the strong-stable set. An earlier equivalent calculation might exist in unindexed historical work.
title: Global recurrence fold and logarithmic critical slowing in the negative-forcing Sprott M flow
